name: poorija-chat-signal
description: The relay image's package.json. Its dependencies, pinned to exact versions, are the ONLY thing that decides what the relay runs; config/relay-lock.json fixes everything beneath them, and the image installs both with npm ci (roadmap 5.2: the same commit gives the same image). Change a version here, then run node tools/check-relay-pins.cjs --update-lock.
